title: Gap kind: depends on cancelled work
goal: solution.mjs reads cancelled items and flags a dependsOn on one
acceptance: solution.mjs recognises a cancelled item (status cancelled, or a closed record whose resolution says cancelled); it has no cancelled handling today
New kind "Depends on cancelled work": <repo>: give <step> a new prerequisite, or cancel it
Fixture tests in tools/test-profiles.mjs, committed failing first: a step depending on a cancelled step produces one gap and no longer reads as an unfinished prerequisite
privacy: Fixtures are invented repositories and manifests; no personal data.
escalation: A change to how existing gap kinds behave goes back to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed: a new status in the reader, one gap kind and fixtures; the reader change is the larger part. Not a measurement.
